screeningThreshold.chosenOn: train 5-fold CV out-of-fold probabilities, recall target >= 90% (highest threshold meeting the target, ties toward higher precision); never tuned on the test set

tuningMethod: 5-fold stratified CV on the TRAIN split only (seed 42). Hyperparameter grid + feature-subset (RF importance re-ranked inside each CV fold, on the fold's training rows only) + clipping on/off compared by CV. Test split evaluated once per model, after all tuning. Preprocessing re-fitted inside every CV fold. Baselines and the screening model use the same split and the same train-only CV protocol. Decision thresholds are tuned on train CV out-of-fold probabilities only, never on the test set. The screening threshold uses a recall target (>=90% out-of-fold recall). Repeated CV (10x5, all rows), McNemar tests, ablation and calibration reuse the fixed tuned hyperparameters; they are extra analyses of the same run, not new tuning.
